summary: NOVONIX Limited filed a Form 6-K containing an ASX announcement dated October 8, 2026, disclosing receipt of ISO 9001:2015 quality management certification following independent assessment of its quality management system. The certification supports customer qualification and supplier approval as the company scales its Riverside facility in Chattanooga, Tennessee, for commercial synthetic graphite anode active material production. No transaction, consideration, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are implicated. This is an ordinary operational milestone disclosure, equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K, and presents no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
